admin_description: The single administrator signs in here. Readers never see this page.
setup_description: Create the single administrator for this site.
recovery_description: Locked out? Reset the admin password with the Recovery Secret from your deployment environment.
setup_failed_description: Check the supplied values or try again later.
setup_success: The admin account was created. The one-time setup code is now permanently disabled.
generic_credentials: Try again. This message stays the same whether the email exists or not.
offline_description: Signing in needs a connection to your Briefly server. Your input is kept.
sessions_revoked: All existing sessions have been revoked — sign in again with the new password.
rotate_secret: Rotate or remove RECOVERY_SECRET from your environment as soon as possible — anyone holding it can reset this account.
recovery_rejected_description: Check the value in your deployment environment. Nothing was changed.
articles_page_description: Each article has one living Draft. Publishing freezes an immutable Publication — editing never touches what’s live.
articles_empty_description: Your first article starts as a private Draft. Nothing goes live until you publish it — deliberately.
articles_load_failed_description: Retry to reload the list. No local or public Article state was changed.
articles_create_failed_description: Nothing was created. Existing Articles are unchanged.
settings_drawer_description: Public content defaults — Articles inherit these unless they override them.
unable_load_settings_description: Refresh the page to try again.
settings_fields_need_attention_descripti: Nothing was saved. Fix the highlighted fields and save again.
couldnt_save_settings_description: The request failed. Your edits are still in the form — retry to send them again.
settings_saved_description: New defaults apply to Articles that inherit them. Articles with overrides are unchanged.
default_public_identity_description: Shown alongside published content. Articles may override any of these per Article.
public_content_note: These values describe public content. They are unrelated to the administrator sign-in email in Account.
account_drawer_description: The single administrator — no other users, roles, or invitations by design.
admin_email_note: Fixed at initialization. This address only signs you in — the public Byline lives in Site Settings.
change_password_description: After a successful change, every existing session is revoked — including this one — and you return to the sign-in page.
unable_change_password_description: Check the current password and new password, then try again.
password_updated_description: All sessions — including this one — have been revoked. Sign in again with the new password.
sign_out_this_session_description: Ends the current browser session only. MFA is not available in this version.
password_updated_notice: Password updated. All sessions were revoked — sign in with the new password.
invalid_byline_url: Use an HTTP or HTTPS URL.
invalid_default_language: Use a valid BCP 47 language tag, such as en or zh-Hans.
